name: graph_checkpoint
title: graph.checkpoint
description: Mark one (stage, key) as complete so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting.

supersedes.description: Keys of EARLIER attempts at this same stage that this checkpoint replaces. Checkpoints are keyed by (runId, stage, key), so a retry under a different key strands the old row and resume_state counts it as work still outstanding forever. Superseded rows are marked, never deleted — a failed attempt is a true record of the run. Name only attempts at the same work: a stage with one key per bug legitimately has some DONE and some FAILED, and superseding a failure because a sibling succeeded would hide the outcome.

repo.description: owner/name. Recorded so a later resume can find this run BY REPOSITORY — an agent starting work does not know a prior runs id.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.

supersededCount.description: Earlier attempts at this stage marked superseded by this call.
